question: The implementer has no network, so it cannot write checksummed Cargo.lock entries for any crate, and CI runs --locked. Should slice 2 be std-only (hand-rolled MCP subset, JSON, SHA-256, HTTP/1.1; http-only upstream, TLS deferred), or may it use rmcp/ureq+rustls/serde_json with a human pushing a `cargo generate-lockfile` fix-up commit to the PR?
reason: Any registry dependency makes `cargo build --locked` fail on the first CI run and neither the implementer nor shepherd can regenerate the lockfile offline; this decides the crate's whole dependency and transport design.

options: std-only, http-only upstream in slice 2 (proposal default)
use crates; a human will push the regenerated Cargo.lock
